secrets.title: THE 3 THINGS THEY DON'T WANT YOU TO KNOW ABOUT AI

slides.t: The 3 things they don't want you to know about AI.
slides.s: Nobody selling you a $2,000 course will say these out loud 👇

slides.t: The free version is enough to start.
slides.s: You don't need a paid plan, a course or a "prompt pack" to get real work done today. Open it and type.

slides.t: AI is only as smart as what you tell it.
slides.x: "I own a bakery. A customer is mad her order was late. Write a kind reply and offer 10% off."

slides.t: You can make AI ask YOU the questions.
slides.s: Add this to the end of anything:
slides.x: "Before you answer, ask me 5 questions so you get this right."

slides.t: Bonus: it makes things up sometimes.
slides.s: Always read before you hit send. It's your assistant, not your boss.

slides.t: The top AI prompts of 2026 for small business owners.
slides.s: Copy and paste. Works in Claude or ChatGPT. Save this 👇

slides.t: The reply writer
slides.x: "Reply to this customer. Friendly, short, answer their question and offer a time to book: [paste message]"

slides.t: The follow up
slides.x: "Write a 2 sentence follow up for a quote I sent 3 days ago. No pressure, just checking in."

slides.t: The review ask
slides.x: "Write a short text asking a happy customer for a Google review. Make it sound like me, not a robot."

slides.t: The price defender
slides.x: "A customer says I'm too expensive. Help me explain my price in a kind, confident way."

slides.t: The day planner
slides.x: "Here's my to do list. Put it in order of what makes me money first: [paste list]"

slides.t: The bad review fixer
slides.x: "Help me reply to this bad review calmly and professionally: [paste review]"

slides.t: The caption machine
slides.x: "Give me 5 short Instagram captions about [what I did today]. Sound human."

slides.t: The secret one
slides.x: "Ask me 5 questions about my business. Then write instructions so you always answer like my best employee."
slides.s2: That's how you build a Business Brain.
